integrity: Proof comprises explicit subgroup classification, Gaussian subspace-intersection enumeration, affine-coset alignment, and neighbor counting; executable finite tests support, not replace, proof.
scientific_limitations: Faithful scalar action and prime-field elementary-abelian kernel only; older general subgroup-intersection literature not completely exhaustively accessible; historical uniqueness and independent mathematical validation not established.
title: Subgroup meet profiles and intersection-graph degree spectra of scalar Frobenius groups
